WWFM.decoder: 1x1 on [h, raster, x_t] -> 5 time-conditioned residual blocks (dil 1,2,4,8,16) -> 1x1

IND.branches: coarse 128 / mid 128 / fine 256; input [x_t, PPG, raster] coefficient of the scale; 6 time-conditioned residual blocks

SF.coupling: 1x1 projections (16 ch): coarse -> mid input; mid and coarse -> fine input (nearest x2 upsampling); no fine -> coarse

time_embedding.injection: additive Linear projection after the first conv of every residual block
